text:
SOURCE-ASSISTED READING of F-t6qr (Stams, Frg. 254), made with the 1574 Accursian Codex (archive.org bub_gb_4tFKnx1BKAYC n497; bub_gb_Ol5_1dLT8CEC n509, n542) in hand. All lines below were reread on the image (canvas 0, Stams_STA_Frg_254_01r02r, 4912x7360, strips rotated 180 degrees); only line openings survive. (x) = expansion; (?) = uncertain; [...] = lost beyond the cut edge or unread. Versos (canvas 1) not read.
